note: Values were read out of the cited manufacturer documents on the retrieval date. Nothing here is inferred, averaged or estimated: a field the manufacturer does not publish is absent from this file rather than present with a placeholder.

candidates.category: Fixtured screwdriving system with automatic feeding
candidates.product_scope: Screwdriving unit — mounted into a station or onto a robot; not a complete standalone cell
candidates.description: Fixtured screwdriver with external feed stroke via slide or robot. Published head diameter 9-24 mm, bit stroke and axial force vary with supply pressure.
caveats: WEBER publishes the weight as approximate ("~9 kg").
No overall dimensions are published, so the installed envelope cannot be checked from the datasheet.
Drive is pneumatic or EC motor; the choice changes the supporting infrastructure the station needs.

candidates.product_scope: Screwdriver spindle — integrated into a station together with a feeder, fixture and controller
candidates.description: K-DUCER transducerised screwdriver for automated applications, working with a KDU control unit. Torque and angle controlled.
caveats: The published 221 x 27 mm is the tool body, not a floor footprint: a complete station also needs a feeder, fixture, frame and controller.
Torque range 0.2-1.2 Nm is far below the SER 30's; whether it suits the joint is an engineering decision the concept does not yet specify.

candidates.category: Brushless clutch fixture-mount screwdriver for automation
candidates.product_scope: Screwdriver spindle — integrated into a station together with a feeder, fixture and controller
candidates.description: Brushless clutch screwdriver in an aluminium housing for installation on robots and automatic machines, driven by an EDU1BL/SG control unit.
interfaces: EDU1BL/SG controller I/O signals (start, stop, error)
caveats: The published 264 x 40 mm is the tool body, not a floor footprint.
Requires an EDU1BL/SG control unit, which is a separate item.

candidates.product_scope: Complete assembly cell — the closest match to a whole station, configured per application
candidates.description: Modular assembly platform with freely programmable axes, equipped with DEPRAG screwdriving function modules and MINIMAT spindles. Loaded manually by an operator or by an automatic feeding system.
caveats: The D3370E brochure carries no technical data table: no dimensions, cycle time, weight, power or interface figures are published.
The brochure claims "short cycle times" in prose. That is marketing language, not a datasheet figure, and has deliberately not been converted into a number.
The cell is configured per application, so its specifications only exist once DEPRAG has quoted a specific configuration.
